purpose: Untouched independent final confirmation and matched episode-profile comparator evaluation
candidate_policy: All three strict joint-composition models fixed. No best-seed substitution, new checkpoint selection, or mutation after observing validation. Existing raw and nominal families use the same data and risk definition.
performance_target: An independent final split must show actual episode adoption >=20 percent, mean team cost gain >=0.5 percent and a positive paired initial-cluster confidence interval, alongside both conditional-risk certificates.
scope: Equally likely nominal/dense initial regimes and equally likely four declared error modes. No per-mode, per-state, arbitrary-noise, or shifted-dynamics risk guarantee.
engineering_limit: Development p95 exceeded 500 ms. Certification does not establish real-time feasibility; include all p95/p99/max and deadline misses.
start_condition: Execute only after calibration selectors are finalized, archived and committed; no test-outcome-dependent selection or tuning.
